description:
Jitsi Meet is an open-source (Apache) WebRTC JavaScript application that uses Jitsi Videobridge to provide high quality, secure and scalable video conferences.


This release updates Electron to 43.8.3, which removes trust for the certificate hierarchy involved in the October 2026 eMudhra intermediate CA key compromise (see https://blog.google/security/protecting-chrome-and-android-users-from-compromised-emudhra-intermediate-ca-certificates/). The desktop app ships its own root store, so updating is the only way to pick this up.
